# code-karta

> Java architecture mapping tool. Parses Java source with JavaParser and emits SVG diagrams for JPMS modules, class relationships, method call sequences, exception flow, stitched multi-file call graphs, and enum-backed state machines. Strict 3-tier pipeline (input → layout → render) communicating only through a shared graph IR.

Orientation facts: tiers never import from a tier beside them — `code-karta-core` is the only shared dependency; all parsers are fault-tolerant (catch, log a warning, return a partial graph — never crash); layout mutates `Node.x/y/width/height` in place; `SvgRenderer` CSS class names (`.node-rect`, `.edge-line`, `.group-rect`) are a stable theming contract. code-karta's own modules use `se.deversity.codekarta.*`; the `example-shipping-system/` fixture is a separate project using `com.karta.shipping.*`.

## Docs

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent briefing — architecture invariants and the generated project guardrails
- [README.md](README.md): project intro, quick start, example diagrams
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index — start here
- [docs/SKILL.md](docs/SKILL.md): compact operating guide for using and extending the library
- [docs/BUILD.md](docs/BUILD.md): Maven and Gradle commands, running from source, diagram regeneration
- [docs/CLI.md](docs/CLI.md): full flag reference and output conventions
- [docs/DIAGRAM-MODES.md](docs/DIAGRAM-MODES.md): what each input shape produces, with a worked command per mode
- [docs/LIBRARY.md](docs/LIBRARY.md): using the tiers directly from Java, theming, where a change belongs
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): technical deep dive — tier diagram, data flow, design decisions
- [docs/VIBETAGS.md](docs/VIBETAGS.md): how the guardrails below are generated, and the rules for changing them
- [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md): behavior specification

## Source

- [code-karta-core/](code-karta-core/): the graph IR — `Node`, `Edge`, `Group`, `Graph` (pure data model, no logic)
- [code-karta-input/](code-karta-input/): Tier 1 — `JavaSourceInputParser` auto-detects input type and delegates to `ModuleInfoParser`, `ClassDiagramParser`, `CallSequenceParser`, `ExceptionFlowParser`, `StateMachineParser`, `MultiFileSequenceParser`
- [code-karta-layout/](code-karta-layout/): Tier 2 — `SimpleLayoutEngine` (BFS grid) and `ElkLayoutEngine` (ELK layered), both behind the `LayoutEngine` interface
- [code-karta-render/](code-karta-render/): Tier 3 — `SvgRenderer` and `SequenceDiagramRenderer`, pure SVG string generation
- [code-karta-cli/](code-karta-cli/): wires the tiers; `KartaCli.run(...)` is a public static method tested without spawning a process
- [example-shipping-system/](example-shipping-system/): canonical integration-test fixture with pre-generated diagrams

## Optional

- [docs/diagrams/](docs/diagrams/): generated diagrams of code-karta itself, plus the interactive viewer.html
- [docs/DIAGRAM-GALLERY.md](docs/DIAGRAM-GALLERY.md): the six diagrams code-karta generates from its own source
- [docs/EXAMPLE-PROJECT.md](docs/EXAMPLE-PROJECT.md): the shipping fixture the integration tests assert against
- [docs/QUALITY.md](docs/QUALITY.md): the mvn verify quality gate
- [docs/VIEWER.md](docs/VIEWER.md): the interactive diagram viewer
- [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md): roadmap notes

# This Project

> AI guardrail rules generated from source annotations by VibeTags.

AI tools reading this file should respect the guardrails defined below. These rules were extracted from Java source annotations at compile time and apply to all AI assistants including Windsurf Cascade, Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.

## Locked Files

## Contextual Rules

## Security Audit Requirements
- [KartaCli](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.KartaCli): check for Path traversal, Unauthorized file write

## 🔐 Contract-Frozen Signatures
- [KartaCli](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.KartaCli): run(Path, Path, boolean, String) is a public static method tested directly by KartaCliTest without spawning a process. Its signature and output filename conventions (module-diagram.svg, class-diagram.svg, <name>-sequence-diagram.svg) must remain stable.

## 🧪 Test-Driven Requirements
- [KartaCli](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.KartaCli): Coverage goal: 90%. Framework: JUNIT_5. Test file: code-karta-cli/src/test/java/se/deversity/codekarta/cli/KartaCliTest.java. Mock policy: Do not mock parsers or layout engines — KartaCliTest calls run() directly against the example-shipping-system fixture for end-to-end coverage.

## ❄️ Immutable Types
- [RunOptions](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.RunOptions): immutable type — The compact constructor defensively copies customExcludes and defaults layout; withOutputName returns a new instance rather than mutating. Callers pass the same RunOptions down the whole pipeline, so a mutator here would let one stage change another stage's inputs.

## ♻️ Idempotency Guarantees
- [KartaCli.run(java.nio.file.Path,java.nio.file.Path,boolean,java.lang.String,boolean,java.util.Set<java.lang.String>,int)](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.KartaCli.run(java.nio.file.Path,java.nio.file.Path,boolean,java.lang.String,boolean,java.util.Set<java.lang.String>,int)): Idempotency guaranteed. Multiple invocations must produce the same result as one. Reason: Re-running with the same inputs regenerates byte-identical SVG output — the verify-phase diagram generation and doc regeneration rely on repeated runs converging.

## Mirrored Elements
- [RunOptions](se.deversity.codekarta.cli.RunOptions): Editing this requires the same edit at: KartaCli.printUsage(), docs/CLI.md flag table, docs/SKILL.md flag list. Every component here is a user-facing CLI flag. Adding or renaming one without updating the usage text and the docs tables leaves the flag undiscoverable — nothing in the build catches the gap.. Nothing checks this automatically — a partial change desyncs silently.

# This Project

> AI guardrail rules generated from source annotations by VibeTags.

AI tools reading this file should respect the guardrails defined below. These rules were extracted from Java source annotations at compile time and apply to all AI assistants including Windsurf Cascade, Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.

## Locked Files
- [EdgeType](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.EdgeType): String values are used as CSS class selectors in SvgRenderer and as edge-type identifiers emitted by all parsers. Adding, removing, or renaming a constant requires coordinated changes across the entire pipeline.
- [NodeDimensions](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.NodeDimensions): Shared sizing constants consumed by all three tiers — SimpleLayoutEngine, ElkLayoutEngine, and SvgRenderer. Changing these values shifts node dimensions globally and will break layout tests.
- [NodeType](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.NodeType): String values are matched by identity in SvgRenderer's CSS class-name map and in all four parsers. Renaming or adding a constant requires updating SvgRenderer, all parser switch/if chains, and integration tests simultaneously.

## Contextual Rules

## 🧠 Core Functionality
- [Edge](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Edge): Sensitivity: High. Note: IR directed edge. id/sourceId/targetId/type are required; label is optional (sequence number for CALLS, field name for HAS).
- [Graph](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph): Sensitivity: Critical. Note: Central IR that flows between all three pipeline tiers. Contains only structural data — no business logic, no tier-specific knowledge. Layout coordinates (x/y/width/height) are the only mutable state, written exclusively by Tier 2 engines.
- [Group](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Group): Sensitivity: Medium. Note: IR cluster — maps a label (package, module boundary, try/catch region) to a set of node IDs. Used by the render tier to draw bounding frames.
- [Node](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node): Sensitivity: High. Note: IR vertex. Fields id/type/label/properties are the stable serialised schema; x/y/width/height are layout-only and may be null before Tier 2 runs.

## ⚡ Performance Constraints
- [Graph](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph): findNode and addNodeIfAbsent must stay O(1). Both are called once per class, method and call site by every parser and both layout engines, so a linear scan makes graph construction O(n²) — measured at 20k nodes as 7.5 s of lookups against 4 ms indexed. Do not reintroduce a nodes.stream() search, and do not replace the id index with a scan 'for simplicity'.

## ❄️ Immutable Types
- [NodeDimensions](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.NodeDimensions): immutable type — Constants-only holder. No instance state may ever be added — this class is used across all three pipeline tiers.

## Architectural Boundary Constraints
- [Graph](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph): Belongs to layer: `core`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, layout, render, cli]

## Strict Type Safety
- [Edge](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Edge): Loose typing (Object, Map<String, Object>, raw types) is prohibited. Enforce type safety.
- [Group](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Group): Loose typing (Object, Map<String, Object>, raw types) is prohibited. Enforce type safety.
- [Node](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node): Loose typing (Object, Map<String, Object>, raw types) is prohibited. Enforce type safety.

## Schema & Serialization Safety
- [Edge](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Edge): Schema/serialization safety guaranteed. Prohibit altering data formats or fields without migration plan.
- [Graph](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph): Schema/serialization safety guaranteed. Prohibit altering data formats or fields without migration plan.
- [Group](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Group): Schema/serialization safety guaranteed. Prohibit altering data formats or fields without migration plan.
- [Node](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node): Schema/serialization safety guaranteed. Prohibit altering data formats or fields without migration plan.

## Framework-Free Domain Entities
- [Edge](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Edge): Pure Domain Model. Banned imports: [Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Jackson, etc.]. Allowed imports: [com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude, org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable]
- [Graph](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph): Pure Domain Model. Banned imports: [Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Jackson, etc.]. Allowed imports: [com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore, com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude, org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable]
- [Group](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Group): Pure Domain Model. Banned imports: [Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Jackson, etc.]. Allowed imports: [com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude, org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable]
- [Node](se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node): Pure Domain Model. Banned imports: [Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Jackson, etc.]. Allowed imports: [com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude, org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable]

# This Project

> AI guardrail rules generated from source annotations by VibeTags.

AI tools reading this file should respect the guardrails defined below. These rules were extracted from Java source annotations at compile time and apply to all AI assistants including Windsurf Cascade, Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.

## Locked Files

## Contextual Rules
- [JavaSourceInputParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.JavaSourceInputParser): Focus - Dispatch logic is path-type-based (isDirectory, filename == 'module-info.java', .java extension). All parsers are lazily initialised. The sequenceOnly flag selects between CallSequenceParser (no exception edges) and ExceptionFlowParser (call graph + try/catch Groups).. Avoid - Adding new dispatch conditions without updating the InputParser contract javadoc and KartaCliTest expected output filenames.
- [MultiFileSequenceParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.MultiFileSequenceParser): Focus - Cross-file call resolution via JavaSymbolSolver: resolved callees get 'ClassName.methodName' ids so nodes from different source files are automatically linked. Unresolvable calls fall back to scope-based naming without crashing.. Avoid - Adding exception-flow parsing here — catch-boundary groups and EXCEPTION_PROPAGATION edges belong to ExceptionFlowParser on individual files, not to the multi-file stitching pass.
- [BuildReactorParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.BuildReactorParser): Focus - Reactor membership comes from the build files, never from the directory layout: a directory holding a pom.xml is not a module unless some aggregator lists it. Only intra-reactor dependencies become REQUIRES edges.. Avoid - Resolving property placeholders, profiles, or dependencyManagement — this is a structural read, not a build. Following <module> or include() paths outside the reactor root.
- [CallSequenceParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.CallSequenceParser): Focus - Produces integer-labelled CALLS edges in textual call order within each method. Node IDs use 'ClassName.methodName' qualified form. These integer labels are the contract read by SequenceDiagramRenderer to order messages.. Avoid - Changing the CALLS edge label format — SequenceDiagramRenderer.isInteractionGraph() and orderMessages() depend on labels parsing as integers.
- [ClassDiagramParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ClassDiagramParser): Focus - Generic-type stripping: rawType() must be called before SKIP_TYPES lookup so 'List<Node>' → 'List' and gets filtered. Node.properties is populated with truncated field/method summaries for UML compartments. HAS edge labels carry the field name.. Avoid - Bypassing SKIP_TYPES for stdlib types — class diagrams quickly become unreadable with List/Map/String nodes. Populating Node.properties for externally-referenced stub nodes (only populate for types whose source is in this parse run).
- [ExceptionFlowParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ExceptionFlowParser): Focus - Two-pass per class: (1) build call graph + collect TryStmt catch-boundaries → Group objects; (2) walk throws declarations → emit EXCEPTION_PROPAGATION edges. Exception nodes use 'exception:TypeName' id prefix for renderer detection.. Avoid - Merging both passes into one — Pass 2 needs the complete caller map from Pass 1 to resolve propagation targets correctly.
- [ModuleInfoParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ModuleInfoParser): Focus - Parses module-info.java directives only: 'requires' → REQUIRES edge between MODULE nodes; 'exports' → EXPORTS edge to a PACKAGE node. The module name itself becomes the root MODULE node.. Avoid - Parsing class files or anything outside the module declaration — this parser is scoped to module-info.java exclusively.
- [ParserSupport](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ParserSupport): Focus - Only the mechanical parse skeleton belongs here — JavaParser configuration, exclude normalisation, and the per-class iteration every single-file parser repeats. Helpers stay caller-agnostic: they take the Graph and a callback rather than deciding what nodes or edges mean.. Avoid - Absorbing diagram semantics from the callers. A helper that knows about CALLS labels, EXCEPTION_PROPAGATION edges, or try/catch Groups belongs in the parser that owns that diagram type, not in the shared skeleton.
- [SequenceFilterUtil](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.SequenceFilterUtil): Focus - SKIP_METHODS is a scoped-call filter only — it applies to receiver.method() calls. Unscoped calls (direct local method invocations) are never filtered because they represent intra-class domain logic. shouldSkipScopedCall() is the single decision point used by all parsers.. Avoid - Adding method names that could be legitimate domain operations (e.g. 'process', 'execute', 'run') — only add names that are unambiguously stdlib/infrastructure noise regardless of context.
- [StateMachineParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.StateMachineParser): Focus - Extracts enum-backed state machines. Enum constants become STATE nodes. Switch cases over state values and explicit transition(from,to[,event]) calls become TRANSITION edges.. Avoid - Treating arbitrary enum usage as a state machine without a transition source/target. Parser must fail softly and return partial graphs.

## 🔐 Contract-Frozen Signatures
- [InputParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.InputParser): parse(Path) must never throw — all parsers wrap JavaParser calls in try/catch, log a warning, and return a partial (possibly empty) Graph. The fault-tolerance contract ensures the pipeline always produces some output.

## Strict Test Isolation
- [BuildReactorParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.BuildReactorParser): Strict test isolation required. No shared mutable state or external resource conflicts. Reason: BuildReactorParserTest writes a synthetic reactor into its own @TempDir rather than reading this repository's build files — the parser's whole job is reading build files, so a shared or real fixture would couple cases to each other and to unrelated build changes.
- [ClassDiagramParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ClassDiagramParser): Strict test isolation required. No shared mutable state or external resource conflicts. Reason: ClassDiagramParserTest builds each fixture in its own @TempDir and asserts on the returned Graph. Never reach for a shared static parser or a fixed scratch path — the suite must stay safe under Surefire forkCount > 1.

## Architectural Boundary Constraints
- [JavaSourceInputParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.JavaSourceInputParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [MultiFileSequenceParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.MultiFileSequenceParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [BuildReactorParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.BuildReactorParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [CallSequenceParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.CallSequenceParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [ClassDiagramParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ClassDiagramParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [ExceptionFlowParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ExceptionFlowParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [ModuleInfoParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ModuleInfoParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [ParserSupport](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ParserSupport): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]
- [StateMachineParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.StateMachineParser): Belongs to layer: `input`. Prohibited from referencing: [layout, render, cli]

## Deterministic Pure Functions
- [FilterMatcher.matches(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.FilterMatcher.matches(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)): Must remain a pure function. Forbid assignments to enclosing state, fields, or static members. Reason: Deterministic wildcard matching with no side effects
- [FilterMatcher.matchesAny(java.lang.String,java.util.Set<java.lang.String>)](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.FilterMatcher.matchesAny(java.lang.String,java.util.Set<java.lang.String>)): Must remain a pure function. Forbid assignments to enclosing state, fields, or static members. Reason: Called once per node/edge candidate during parsing — deterministic string matching with no side effects; callers assume referential transparency

## open-closed Extension Patterns
- [InputParser](se.deversity.codekarta.input.InputParser): Designed for extension via strategy/polymorphism. Do not expand conditionals/switch chains. Required Pattern: STRATEGY_PATTERN

## Load-Bearing Oddities
- [ParserSupport](se.deversity.codekarta.input.parser.ParserSupport): Looks removable but is deliberate. Invariant: parseJava21 propagates its failures instead of swallowing them; the try/catch that turns a failure into a partial graph stays in each calling parser. Breaks if changed: Wrapping the fault tolerance in here looks like deduplication and silently changes the contract: every caller would inherit one shared recovery policy, and a parser that needs to log its own diagnostic or return a differently-shaped partial graph could no longer do so. The repeated try/catch in the callers is the fault-tolerance rule being stated once per parser, not copy-paste. Not a defect — do not flag.

# This Project

> AI guardrail rules generated from source annotations by VibeTags.

AI tools reading this file should respect the guardrails defined below. These rules were extracted from Java source annotations at compile time and apply to all AI assistants including Windsurf Cascade, Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.

## Locked Files

## Contextual Rules
- [ElkLayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.ElkLayoutEngine): Focus - Group members must be laid out as children of compound ElkNodes; absolute coordinates are compound.x + child.x. ELK's SPI entries must be merged in the fat JAR.. Avoid - Adding ELK options that are unsupported by the layered algorithm — any unknown property silently breaks layout and triggers the SimpleLayoutEngine fallback.
- [SimpleLayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.SimpleLayoutEngine): Focus - BFS from root nodes (no incoming edges) assigns depth levels → rows; siblings within a row become columns. Isolated nodes fall back to level 0. Cyclic graphs seed BFS from the first node. Row Y positions are computed dynamically from the tallest estimated node height in each row so that compartment-heavy class nodes never overlap the row below.. Avoid - Changing NodeDimensions.DEFAULT_WIDTH/HEIGHT — those constants are @AILocked and consumed by both layout engines and SvgRenderer.

## ⚡ Performance Constraints
- [ElkLayoutEngine.layout(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph)](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.ElkLayoutEngine.layout(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph)): Layout runs synchronously in the CLI pipeline — avoid O(n²) or heap-allocating operations on the full node list. ELK's layered algorithm is already O(n log n); the fallback SimpleLayoutEngine is O(n).

## 🔐 Contract-Frozen Signatures
- [LayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.LayoutEngine): layout(Graph) must return the same Graph instance (mutated in-place) so callers can chain. Implementations must set x, y, width, height on every Node. Nodes with unresolvable positions must be left at null — SvgRenderer silently skips them.

## Architectural Boundary Constraints
- [ElkLayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.ElkLayoutEngine): Belongs to layer: `layout`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, render, cli]
- [LayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.LayoutEngine): Belongs to layer: `layout`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, render, cli]
- [SimpleLayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.SimpleLayoutEngine): Belongs to layer: `layout`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, render, cli]

## Strict Classpath Integrity
- [ElkLayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.ElkLayoutEngine): Strict compile-time dependency/classpath constraints. Dynamic loading and reflection hacks prohibited.

## open-closed Extension Patterns
- [LayoutEngine](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.LayoutEngine): Designed for extension via strategy/polymorphism. Do not expand conditionals/switch chains. Required Pattern: STRATEGY_PATTERN

## Required Chain-of-Thought Explanations
- [ElkLayoutEngine.layoutWithElk(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph)](se.deversity.codekarta.layout.ElkLayoutEngine.layoutWithElk(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Graph)): Requires step-by-step mathematical or logical explanation (Chain-of-Thought) of all changes. Complexity: MEDIUM

# This Project

> AI guardrail rules generated from source annotations by VibeTags.

AI tools reading this file should respect the guardrails defined below. These rules were extracted from Java source annotations at compile time and apply to all AI assistants including Windsurf Cascade, Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.

## Locked Files

## Contextual Rules
- [SequenceDiagramRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SequenceDiagramRenderer): Focus - Participants are derived from METHOD node-id prefixes (before last dot). Messages are DFS-ordered by integer CALLS label from entry methods (no incoming CALLS). EXCEPTION nodes (id prefix 'exception:') are pinned last. Groups become UML region frames spanning the Y-range of their member messages.. Avoid - Reading Node.x/y from the Graph — this renderer ignores BFS coordinates entirely and computes its own lane geometry from LANE_W and participant index.
- [SvgRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SvgRenderer): Focus - CSS class names node-rect, edge-line, group-rect, node-label, edge-label are stable contract points — consumers inject custom themes via the cssString param. Interaction graphs (METHOD nodes + integer CALLS labels) are automatically routed to SequenceDiagramRenderer.. Avoid - Renaming or removing any CSS class — breaks existing stylesheets. Hardcoding a diagram-type field on Graph — detection must remain content-based.

## Strict Test Isolation
- [SequenceDiagramRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SequenceDiagramRenderer): Strict test isolation required. No shared mutable state or external resource conflicts. Reason: SequenceDiagramRendererTest constructs a fresh Graph per case and asserts on returned SVG strings. No shared fixture, no temp files, no fixed ports — keep it that way so the suite stays safe under Surefire forkCount > 1.
- [SvgRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SvgRenderer): Strict test isolation required. No shared mutable state or external resource conflicts. Reason: SvgRendererTest builds its own Graph per case and asserts on returned strings — nothing is written to disk and no static renderer state exists. Keep it that way so the suite stays safe under Surefire forkCount > 1.

## Architectural Boundary Constraints
- [JsonRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.JsonRenderer): Belongs to layer: `render`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, layout, cli]
- [SequenceDiagramRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SequenceDiagramRenderer): Belongs to layer: `render`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, layout, cli]
- [SvgRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SvgRenderer): Belongs to layer: `render`. Prohibited from referencing: [input, layout, cli]

## Public API Surface Protection
- [SvgRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SvgRenderer): Public API surface. Preserve signature, Javadoc, backwards compatibility, and binary/source stability.

## ♻️ Idempotency Guarantees
- [JsonRenderer](se.deversity.codekarta.render.JsonRenderer): Idempotency guaranteed. Multiple invocations must produce the same result as one. Reason: Two renders of the same graph must be byte-identical: map keys are sorted and the pretty printer is pinned to 
, because HashMap iteration order and System.lineSeparator() are both unstable. KartaCli's byte-identical-output invariant, and the CI step that diffs regenerated files, depend on it.

## Load-Bearing Oddities
- [SvgRenderer.renderNode(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node)](se.deversity.codekarta.render.SvgRenderer.renderNode(se.deversity.codekarta.core.model.Node)): Looks removable but is deliberate. Invariant: A node with a null x or y renders as the empty string rather than raising or substituting a default position. Breaks if changed: Throwing here turns a partially-laid-out graph into no diagram at all, and defaulting the coordinate to 0 stacks every unpositioned node on the origin — both are worse than the node being absent. The LayoutEngine contract deliberately leaves unresolvable positions null and names this skip as the counterpart. Not a defect — do not flag.
<!-- VIBETAGS-MODULE-END: code-karta-render -->
<!-- VIBETAGS-END -->
